user.title: Add Music Assistant Conductor
user.description:
Conductor adds a dashboard card for your Music Assistant speakers — pick a room, see what's playing, control it, and browse or search your music.

It works through the Music Assistant integration you already have, so there's nothing to enter here. Select **Submit**, then add a **Music Assistant Conductor** card to any dashboard.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Music Assistant Conductor is already set up. Add its card to a dashboard to use it.
abort.music_assistant_required: Set up the Music Assistant integration first, then add Music Assistant Conductor.
